call_path.description:
A call-path/v1 document. Line-oriented, one contract per document:
call-path/v1
from symbol "app::start" in "src/app.rs"
direct-call symbol "service::load" in "src/service.rs"
direct-call canonical "store::read"
prohibit-through symbol "legacy::shim"
exclude-from-projection symbol "tracing::span"
Exactly one from, one to six ordered direct-call lines, then zero to sixteen prohibit-through and exclude-from-projection lines. Selectors are symbol "<qualified-name>" [in "<project-relative-path>"] or canonical "<id>". Any line the grammar cannot read is reported as an unresolved clause and yields graph_disposition "unknown" rather than being skipped.

call_path.description:
A call-path/v1 document. Line-oriented, one contract per document:
call-path/v1
from symbol "app::start" in "src/app.rs"
direct-call symbol "service::load" in "src/service.rs"
direct-call canonical "store::read"
prohibit-through symbol "legacy::shim"
exclude-from-projection symbol "tracing::span"
Exactly one from, one to six ordered direct-call lines, then zero to sixteen prohibit-through and exclude-from-projection lines. Selectors are symbol "<qualified-name>" [in "<project-relative-path>"] or canonical "<id>". Any line the grammar cannot read is reported as an unresolved clause and yields graph_disposition "unknown" rather than being skipped.

tools.description: Verify one exact indexed source call path, written in the call-path/v1 grammar, against a pinned publication.

call_path.description:
A call-path/v1 document. Line-oriented, one contract per document:
call-path/v1
from symbol "app::start" in "src/app.rs"
direct-call symbol "service::load" in "src/service.rs"
direct-call canonical "store::read"
prohibit-through symbol "legacy::shim"
exclude-from-projection symbol "tracing::span"
Exactly one from, one to six ordered direct-call lines, then zero to sixteen prohibit-through and exclude-from-projection lines. Selectors are symbol "<qualified-name>" [in "<project-relative-path>"] or canonical "<id>". Any line the grammar cannot read is reported as an unresolved clause and yields graph_disposition "unknown" rather than being skipped.
